teach.goal: Como não traduzir palavra por palavra.
solo: Pergunte por que o erro acontece em português e como evitar.
group: Compare erro e forma natural: There is two showers. → There are two showers. | Have a shop at the gate. → There is a shop at the gate. | You should to buy wood. → You should buy wood..
Peça que digam a forma natural em voz alta.

errors.w: Have a shop at the gate.

facts.label: Lugares e conselhos
facts.sub: Use there is/are para dizer o que existe e should + verbo base para dar conselhos: There is a shop. You should buy wood there.

facts.label: Há
facts.sub: Use there is com uma coisa: There is a shop. Use there are com várias: There are two showers. Para perguntar, inverta: Is there a shop? Are there any showers?

facts.label: Conselho
facts.sub: Use should + verbo base para dar conselho: You should buy wood. You should bring a warm jacket. Não use to depois de should. Só use a forma afirmativa neste nível.

paragraphs: It is Friday afternoon at a campsite near Belfast. Tall trees stand around a quiet lake. Wendy works at the gate. Her friend Lia comes with a big backpack. Lia wants to camp for two nights. Wendy shows her the campsite.
“Hi, Lia! Welcome to the campsite.” says Wendy. “Thanks, Wendy! Is there a good place for our tent?” says Lia. “Yes, there is a flat place near the lake.” says Wendy.
